metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Peterborough for Asian weddings, hotel receptions, proms and corporate events across the city and nearby towns. Request a free quote.
h1: Photo Booth Hire Peterborough for Weddings, Proms and Business Events
intro: Peterborough is a cathedral city with a full and varied events calendar, from multi-day Asian weddings in banqueting suites to hotel receptions, school proms and company conferences. We bring the booth, the attendant and the props, and we plan generous time for the drive so that everything is built and tested before your first guest arrives.

sections.heading: The city, its neighbourhoods and nearby towns
paragraphs: Peterborough sits in the north of Cambridgeshire and forms part of our Cambridgeshire coverage. We work right across the city, including the centre, Orton, Hampton, Werrington, Bretton and Stanground, and out to Yaxley and Whittlesey. We also cover Market Deeping, just over the border in Lincolnshire, which is close enough that many couples look at venues on both sides of the county line. Wherever the party is, the package and the team are the same.

sections.heading: Planning the longer journey to Peterborough
paragraphs: Peterborough is further out than most of the places we visit regularly, so we treat the journey as part of the event plan rather than an afterthought. Our team leaves early, allows for traffic on the A1(M), A47, A15 and A605, and arrives with time to spare before the 45 to 60 minute build, which is free and never counted against your hire. Delivery and setup are included, and if a travel contribution applies to your venue it is shown on the quote up front.

Most hotels, conference venues and banqueting suites around the city have car parks and a delivery entrance, so we unload close to the door and move the vehicle once the kit is inside. Barns and golf clubs can mean a longer carry, so mention any gravel paths or steps. Every booth needs one standard socket, apart from the Inflatable Booth, which needs two. Upstairs rooms suit the LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth and Retro Pod; the larger booths need a lift or a ground-floor space.

sections.heading: Multi-day weddings and large family celebrations
paragraphs: Peterborough's South Asian community means many of our bookings here are weddings that run across several days, with guest lists in the hundreds. Rather than one booking, families often ask us for the mehndi, the main day and the reception, each with its own print design. Because we are travelling further, we agree arrival times for every day in advance and confirm them with the venue the week before, so a change to the running order never catches anyone out.

For privacy, the enclosed Party Booth keeps photos behind a curtain, and the Inflatable Booth gives groups of up to ten their own glowing space away from the busy hall. A ladies' session can be arranged on request, with our attendant running a separate queue for an agreed slot. The city's mix of communities also means we are often asked for template wording in more than one language, which we are happy to set as long as you supply the exact text.

sections.heading: Hotels, conference rooms and community halls
paragraphs: Hotels host a good share of Peterborough's weddings and Christmas parties, while conference venues look after company launches, training days and awards dinners. Banqueting suites handle the largest family celebrations. Outside the city, barns and golf clubs suit rustic weddings, summer parties and milestone birthdays, and community centres and school halls are the usual home for proms, christenings, Eid parties and children's events. Whatever the room, we ask for a floor plan early so the booth goes where guests will actually see it.

sections.heading: Booths that work well in Peterborough
paragraphs: For hotel weddings, the Magic Mirror is the classic pick, with on-screen animations, a DSLR camera and a guest book of prints for the couple to keep. Corporate events in the city's conference venues lean towards the GIF Booth, which skips the printer and sends branded GIFs and boomerangs to guests instantly. School proms and community-centre parties are well served by the LCD SlimPod, which needs a floor space of just 1.5 by 2 metres, and the Inflatable Booth makes a centrepiece in a high-ceilinged banqueting suite.

sections.heading: Advice for proms, office parties and birthdays
paragraphs: Corporate clients usually want branding throughout: a logo on the print template, a custom animated overlay and digital copies for the marketing team afterwards. Tell us the brand colours and we will send a proof before the event. For Christmas parties, book as early as you can, and consider opening the booth after dinner, when colleagues are relaxed and far more likely to queue.

For proms, a single booth running through the evening works well in a school hall or hotel function room, and unlimited sessions mean students can come back with every group of friends. Birthday parties, from a first in a community centre to a fortieth at a golf club, get a template built around the theme and the guest of honour. Packages from £239 include the attendant, props, prints and digital copies.

faqs.q: Where do you park and unload at Peterborough venues?
faqs.a: Hotels, conference venues and banqueting suites in and around the city generally have car parks and a delivery door, so we unload there and park where the venue directs. For barns, golf clubs and community halls, tell us about any gates, gravel or long walks so we can plan the carry.

faqs.q: Can you set up in a first-floor function room?
faqs.a: Yes, with the right booth. The LCD SlimPod, GIF Booth and Retro Pod can be carried up stairs by our team. The Magic Mirror, Party Booth and Inflatable Booth need a lift or a ground-floor room. Let us know the layout when you book and we will advise.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee for Peterborough?
faqs.a: Delivery and setup are included; if any travel contribution ever applies to a far-flung venue it is shown on the quote up front. Because Peterborough is further out, we also build the longer journey into our schedule, so the team arrives in good time for the free 45 to 60 minute setup.

faqs.q: Do you cover Market Deeping, Yaxley and Whittlesey?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly travel beyond the city to Yaxley and Whittlesey, and across the Lincolnshire border to Market Deeping. Send us the venue address with your date and we will confirm availability and include everything on one clear quote.

faqs.q: Can you run a ladies-only session at a Peterborough wedding?
faqs.a: Yes. On request, our attendant can run a separate queue for women for an agreed part of the evening, and the enclosed Party Booth keeps photos private behind its curtain. Share the running order with us and we will fit the session around the meal and speeches.
